Title: FF_DSID_001 — Orders: At least one MetadataOnlyDelivery order shows DSID in grid
Preconditions: PROD Fulfillment Console; calendar = Today (default); Job type = MetadataOnlyDelivery; Partner = PP YT FSP UK
Steps:
1. Log in to Fulfillment Console
2. Set Today as the default date range
3. Left filter → Job type → MetadataOnlyDelivery
4. Left filter → Partner → PP YT FSP UK
5. Open Table View (Manage columns) on Orders tab
6. Enable DSID column and apply/save
7. Starting from the first order row, check the DSID column; if blank, check the next rows
Expected Result: At least one order row displays a populated DSID value in the Orders grid

Title: FF_DSID_002 — Orders: Table DSID matches last DSID in Details panel
Preconditions: Same as FF_DSID_001; at least one order with DSID visible in grid
Steps:
1. From FF_DSID_001, click the order row that shows DSID
2. Open the Details panel (Details button if not auto-opened)
3. Locate DSID in the Details panel (multiple DSID values may be listed)
4. Compare the table DSID with the last DSID shown in the Details panel
Expected Result: The DSID value in the Orders grid matches the last DSID value displayed in the Details panel

Title: FF_DSID_003 — Line Items: Table DSID matches last DSID in Details panel
Section: Fulfillment Console > BSD-29870 > Line Items > DSID
Preconditions: PROD; Today default; Job type = MetadataOnlyDelivery; Partner = PP YT FSP UK
Steps:
1. Switch to Line Items tab
2. Apply Job type = MetadataOnlyDelivery and Partner = PP YT FSP UK
3. Open Table View and enable DSID column
4. Find at least one line item row with populated DSID (skip blank rows)
5. Open Details panel for that row
6. Compare grid DSID with the last DSID in Details panel
Expected Result: Line Items grid DSID matches the last DSID value in the Details panel
